failures.criterion: The architect's item 3 and the invariant: a retried start after a failed forget is not delivered twice; every kept decision reaches its architect once
failures.evidence: Red test TestAStartWhoseForgetFailedIsNotDeliveredAgainAfterItsTurn (packages/daemon/internal/daemon/parked_decision_test.go, commit df02ec30). Command: `cd packages/daemon && LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN=... go test -count=1 -run TestAStartWhoseForgetFailedIsNotDeliveredAgainAfterItsTurn ./internal/daemon/` -> FAIL: `the retried start queued &supervise.Delivery{ID:"outbox:72", Task:"a person decided on the tree: dispatch://LEGION-1/ask/ask-1", ... DeliveredAt:... MarkedBy:"outbox:72" ...} again after the architect's turn on it ended; want each decision told once`. The delivered mark (start-delivered:<row>) is written in forgetKept's transaction, after RequestDeliver has already queued the task in the supervisor's store. When that transaction does not commit (a database error, or the daemon dying in the gap: the reviewer's crash window), the row retries with no mark. supervise.queue (delivery.go:105-111) dedupes only against a delivery still pending; once the architect's turn on the task ends and the delivery retires, the retry queues the same task again and the architect is prompted with each kept decision a second time. The state table's crash case ('the retry's RequestDeliver with the same id and task is accepted as already queued') holds only while that delivery is still pending. TestARetriedStartDeliversItsTaskOnce covers the ClaimReady-fails-after-the-forget case only, where the mark did commit. A fix has to make 'this row's task was delivered' durable no later than the delivery itself: for example, have the retry treat its own delivery id as delivered when the claim already queued or retired it, or write the mark in the transaction that persists the delivery.
